rules.title: Home rule petition authorizing Boston rent stabilization (H.3744)
rules.requirement: Proposed special law that would authorize the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization. The page does not include the bill text or any cap formula.
rules.quoted_span: By Representative Montaño of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 3744) of Samantha Montaño (with the approval of the mayor and city council) that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.extraction_note: The source is a bill-history page only, with no substantive bill text, so there are no cap formula, coverage, exemptions or penalties to extract. The last action listed is on 9/9/2024: 'Accompanied a study order, see H5035.' It was marked failed because the bill was sent to study and the 193rd session (2023-2024) ended without enactment. This status is an inference from the bill history. The petition is a state special law that would authorize city action; it is recorded at city level per the manifest.

rules.title: Home rule petition authorizing Boston tenant eviction protections (H.3744)
rules.requirement: Proposed special law that would authorize the City of Boston to implement tenant eviction protections. The page does not include the bill text, permitted causes, notice or relocation terms.
rules.quoted_span: By Representative Montaño of Boston, a petition (accompanied by bill, House, No. 3744) of Samantha Montaño (with the approval of the mayor and city council) that the city of Boston be authorized to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections.
rules.extraction_note: The source is a bill-history page only, with no substantive text on eviction causes, notice or relocation. The bill accompanied a study order (H5035) on 9/9/2024, and the 193rd session ended. It is treated as failed, which is an inference from the bill history.
